tango.review_method: Every decoded frame of the actual compiled MP4 inspected in ordered frame strips; iteration 1 and corrected iteration 2 were both decoded from their encoded MP4s.

iterations.highest_value_visible_defect: During the release/crossing, both actors' upper limbs collapsed into long horizontal bars and X clutter, visually implying an authored collision/grip that the evidence explicitly leaves UNKNOWN.
iterations.correction: Tuck Actor A's K4–K6 arms down, send B's lead arm ahead/up and rear arm high/right, and preserve only torso/root geometric overlap so the crossing remains legible without inventing contact.

iterations.visible_basis: All 73 decoded frames reviewed in order. Preparation changes internal shape before speed; K3 is a crooked loaded spring; K4–K6 cut through one monotonic leftward commitment without a contact glyph event; K7 raises the lagging rear arm through clean upper negative space; K8 settles farther left with unequal base and high distal lag instead of reverse recoil or idle reset.

noodle_queen.review_method: Final encoded MP4 decoded to all 73 ordered frames; full ASCII/JSON specimen audited after Tango PASS.

verdict.TASTE: PASS — the set, sink, crooked spring, release cut, crossing, high counter-arc, and debt settle are materially different silhouette phases rather than one mannequin translated across the floor.
verdict.FUNCTION: PASS — OBSERVED source timestamps are kept separate from INFERRED compile classes/holds/arcs; support/contact uncertainty remains explicit; the media contains only the abstract ASCII rig.
verdict.CONTEMPT: PASS — the repair rejects the predecessor's truncated media, generic symmetry, equal-spacing tween feel, false contact bars, reverse recoil, and idle-reset recovery.
verdict.specificity: B's pelvis leads the compression while head/rear hand lag; release aligns head/pelvis/lead arm left; recovery leaves the distal rear arm late and high while the root never reverses.
verdict.silhouette: PASS — K3, K4, K7, and K8 each carry a distinct readable contour and directional idea.
verdict.embodied_force_intent: PASS — visible load is spent into one leftward commitment, then momentum is paid by overshoot and distal lag.
verdict.economic_not_cheap: PASS — nine decisive keys and guarded curved bridges do the necessary work; connective frames connect rather than perform.
